g.text: AIRLINE CHECK-IN AND BOARDING PLATFORM · HUB AND SPOKE
Production and test reach the shared hub on their own spokes and never route to each other.

Kiosks, counters and the mobile app reach production through one ingress tier, which hands bookings to the check-in service and gate lists to the boarding workers. The shared-services hub runs in two regions and fails over between
them; the test environment attaches as a second spoke with masked passenger data.
Shared services hub · one network, two regions
Both regions advertise one service range to each spoke · the reservation system is reached through the egress gateways only
private addresses only · no route from web
calls and routes inside the platform
